Display the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform news feed

Source: R/en_helpers.R
get_news.Rd

Fetches the RSS news feed from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform and displays the entries in the console. Useful for checking platform maintenance windows, data publication delays, and other announcements that may affect API availability.

Usage

get_news(feed_url = .feed_url, n = 5L)

Arguments

feed_url

the URL of the RSS news feed from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.

n

Integer scalar. Maximum number of feed items to display. Defaults to 5L. Use Inf to show all items.

Value

A tibble of feed items with columns title, pub_date, and description, returned invisibly.

Examples

entsoeapi::get_news()
#>
